text_block_list.text:
Since Satono Crown wasn't feeling well,
I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm going to rest for just a bit.
I promise I'll get back in shape...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is a video game world.
Clear all the stages, and you'll be able to return to your original world, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Dia!?
What do you mean by—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They're gone. ...*sigh*
I don't understand half of what's going on,
but I guess I just have to do it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... first up is the "Home Run Derby."
I'm your opponent, by the way—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? Playing baseball with Cheval?
Talk about jumping straight to a high-difficulty stage!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, it doesn't matter who the opponent is.
I'll just give it my all and win!
(*CRRRACK!*)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now it's Kitasan's turn...
I wonder what we're supposed to do here?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, it's a rhythm game!
Time your call-and-response with the song
and aim for 2,000,070,000 points!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Eep?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, yo-i yo-i♪
Haaahn♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yo! And-a-heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Great! A perfect score!
See, you can do it when you put your mind to it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you've finally reached the final stage, Kura-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The final stage is a special crane game!
And the prize is none other than—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!? What's the deal with this,
it's Paka-Petit size!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By the way, if you fail, the machine will be taken away.
And you, Trainer, will have to become my trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Eep?! You've got to be kidding me!
Trainer, I'll save you right now...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Stay calm, gauge the angle—
Right there!
(Ta-daaa!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Tài hǎo le!
Trainer acquired!!
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Crown! You beat the game!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, I did it—wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A dream, huh... Well, figures. But that Trainer
prize was kind of small and cute.

Perhaps the mysterious dream served as a refreshing change of pace,
as Satono Crown seemed to have recovered her health.
